Subject: Intro + Handoff: Atlas Retail observability kickoff

Hi Stephanie / team,

Quick handoff — Atlas (Elena & Samir) signed last week and want to start observability & ops onboarding next week. Attaching the requirements PDF they sent during procurement. Key asks that came up in onboarding prep:

- Dashboards for per-tenant latency and cost breakdowns
- Tracing hooks for cross-service request correlation (OpenTelemetry preferred)
- Error taxonomy + mapping to alert severity
- Alert routing into PagerDuty + a Slack channel per environment
- A customer-facing incident runbook and an ops runbook for our oncall

What I need from CS/Implementation: ownership for the kick-off, a proposed 4-week rollout plan, and a first-pass runbook so Atlas can OK the format.

Proposed kickoff window: Tues 12/14 or Wed 12/15 (US PST mornings). Elena — are you available?

Attachment: atlas-observability-requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success (AE)
Redwood Inference

2) Instrumentation overview: tracing + metrics endpoints (10m)
3) Dashboard & alerting topology review (10m)
4) Next steps, milestone dates, and owners (5–15m)

Attendees I suggest: Stephanie (CS), Diego (Infra eng), Marissa (CS Ops), Elena, Samir, Atlas SRE rep (if available).

I can run it Tues 12/14 at 10:00am PT or Wed 12/15 at 9:00am PT. If either works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and pre-read.

Action items for this thread:
- Diego: draft recommended tracing hooks + sample config

- Monica: confirm Atlas internal SRE attendee

I’ll also put together a first-pass incident runbook template for review.

Best,

Hi Stephanie — thanks, 12/14 10:00am PT works for me. I’ve looped in Riya from our SRE team (riya.shetty@atlasretail.com) in the SRE group alias. A few notes from our side so the kickoff can be tight:

- We use OpenTelemetry collector in prod; tracing SDK standard is fine.
- We have strict routing for P1 alerts (PagerDuty -> SRE lead) and P2 alerts to a shared oncall rotation; would like to review the alert routing config.
- We already emit a set of span attributes; we need help mapping those to the error taxonomy you mentioned.

Please include any pre-read config snippets so our SRE can review before the call.

Elena
Director of Platform Engineering
Atlas Retail
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@atlasretail.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Handoff: Atlas Retail observability kickoff — tracing & sample configs

Stephanie / team — attaching a short runbook draft and a sample OpenTelemetry config snippet we should share as a pre-read. Highlights:

- Tracing hooks: instrument incoming API gateway and worker processes; add span attribute `atlas.request_id` and `tenant_id`.
- Suggested sampler: parent-based trace sampling with 1% baseline and 100% sampling for error spans and requests with latencies > 1s.
- KV caching note: we recommend excluding large payload fields from spans to avoid excessive trace size.
- Suggested alert mapping (first pass):
  - P1: service_error (5xx rate spike), policy_breach (auth/permission failure)
  - P2: elevated_latency (p50->p95 divergence), increased_error_rate (2–5% sustained)

Attachment: runbooks/atlas-incident-runbook.md

I’ll be on the kickoff to run the instrumentation and alerting slides.

—Diego
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-14T07:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff invite + SLO/Acceptance checklist

Invite sent for Tue 12/14 10:00am PT (calendar link in invite). I also attached a first-pass SLO & acceptance criteria CSV so we can converge on measurable checkpoints during the 4-week rollout. Quick milestones (summary):

Week 0 (kickoff): confirm instrumentation points + agree on error taxonomy
Week 1: dashboards up (latency/cost/SLOs), basic alerts configured
Week 2: tracing validation + sample traces verified across envs
Week 3: runbook iteration and tabletop for P1 scenarios
Week 4: handback to Atlas SRE for runbook sign-off + final tuning

Acceptance checklist (examples):
- Dashboards show per-tenant p50/p95 latency and cost per 1000 tokens
- P1 PagerDuty escalation fires correctly in synthetic test
- Traces include `tenant_id` and `atlas.request_id` fields across the call path
- Runbook includes contact matrix and rollback steps

Attachment: slo-metrics-proposal.csv

Marissa
CS Operations
Redwood Inference

- Marissa’s acceptance checklist looks good; we’ll add one item to verify cost attribution for cached responses.
- Diego’s runbook template is a good starting point; we’ll review and send feedback by 12/20.

Next actions:
- Redwood: finalize runbook and confirm P1 test plan (owner: Diego)
- Atlas: run pre-production instrumentation and share sample traces (owner: Riya)
- Joint: tabletop for a P1 scenario during Week 3 (scheduling to follow)

Attachment: none (runbook link in thread)

Elena Torres
